summary: Trust-and-usability remediation cycle complete. Region semantics corrected (region selects the displayed price, never which rows exist) so all 99 certified Energy Star SKUs are reachable in browse and search; SSR/currency mismatch eliminated; priceless rows no longer lead a price-descending list; homepage stats and methodology page now derive from the database instead of hardcoded claims; certified vs reference provenance is disclosed in the UI and filterable; price filters, region coverage and CI are live. 56 web tests, 13 Python tests, clean lint/types, 16/16 build routes. Also removed a per-filter-change storm of 24 background detail-page renders and the duplicate server round trip behind the URL sync.
